model.description: OMG brings you Shady Icee, a premium hybrid flower that delivers the perfect balance of relaxation and uplift in a convenient 3.5g pre-pack. This carefully cultivated strain combines the best of both worlds, offering effects that ease tension while keeping your mind clear and focused. Shady Icee delights the senses with frosty, resinous buds that showcase vibrant colors and exceptional quality. The flavor profile features refreshing notes of citrus and sweet tropical fruit with subtle earthy undertones, creating a smooth and enjoyable experience from first inhale to last. Ideal for any time of day, this hybrid provides a euphoric, happy high that promotes creativity and social connection without overwhelming sedation. Whether you're unwinding after work or sparking inspiration for your next project, OMG's Shady Icee delivers consistent quality and potent effects. Perfect for both seasoned enthusiasts and those seeking a well-rounded cannabis experience.
